name: Ashley Ross

text.trigger: A player controls Ashley Ross and is not exiled.
text.vignette: Ashley paces the colony wall with a notebook, sketching improvements nobody asked for. Two projects look possible with the materials at hand, and both will leave her cold and exposed for hours.

options.raise-walkways: Build raised walkways: from now on, no survivor rolls exposure after attacking zombies at colony entrance 1. Ashley Ross rolls exposure twice for the work.
options.dig-a-waste-pit: Dig a bigger waste pit: from now on the waste check costs 1 morale for each full 15 cards on the pile, no longer each full 10. Ashley Ross rolls exposure once.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #57; The walkways skip exposure for any survivor that attacks at colony entrance 1 (the printed text does not name Ashley as the attacker).
